chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 330: The Blood Drill — Han Li Faces an Instant-Kill Technique
chapter_meta_description: Emperor Yue reveals the Blood Drill, a one-shot piercing attack that nearly kills Han Li. Forced to burn his puppets as a rearguard, Han Li makes the cold call to retreat. A classic Mortal Stream survival chapter.
og_title: The Blood Drill: When a Perfect Defense Means Nothing
og_description: Emperor Yue’s hidden killing move punches through Han Li’s shields in an instant. Han Li’s only answer: run. Chapter 330 of A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality is a masterclass in knowing when to fold.
twitter_title: Han Li dodges death by inches in RMJI Ch. 330
twitter_description: The Blood Drill goes through everything—White Phosphorus Shield, tortoise shell, sword shield—and Han Li still lives. Barely. Then he runs. That’s the Mortal Stream way.

lore_anchors.definition: A one-shot, hyper-compressed true-essence projectile that a demonic cultivator cultivates in secret over a long period; it takes immense pain to form and is used as a sure-kill trump card.
A self-only healing pill for practitioners of specific demonic arts; it restores vitality and wounds instantly but permanently damages the user’s cultivation base.
Alchemical treasures that greatly assist Core Formation; the two orbs in this arc are a matched set, one from the dead blue-robed man and one now in Emperor Yue’s possession.
The title claimed by the blue-robed man who died under Han Li’s Heaven Thunder Seed; Emperor Yue, the current enemy, may be the true holder of the title or a usurper who absorbed his power.
A speed-focused flying artifact refined from Ink Flood Dragon fin and tail; extremely fast but lacks defensive capabilities. Locked translation.
